description: Register a new autoload. autoloadPath takes res://... or a project path. singleton defaults to true. No Godot process is used. An autoload that stops the engine before a headless operation is dispatched fails all of them: run validate on it first. Returns: autoload { name, path, singleton } read back from project.godot, and a tip. Errors if the name exists (use update_autoload), or a singleton shares its name with a class_name a project script declares (the engine then drops the script).

autoloadPath.description: Path to the script or scene (e.g. "res://autoload/my_manager.gd" or "autoload/my_manager.gd")

projectPath.description: Path to the Godot project directory

singleton.description: Register as a globally accessible singleton by name (default: true)

name: add_autoload

path.description: res:// path of the script or scene.

warnings.description: Present only when the scan for a class_name clash could not cover every .gd file, or the script extends a chain that could not be followed to its end, so a clash may remain.
